vectors.description: Only prose wording in a Bible doc changes; the rule's threshold/severity/blocking is untouched.
A code comment or internal refactor changes with no behavioral difference — a human should confirm before assuming VALIDATION_VERSION_UNCHANGED.
A MAJOR rule-version change per 108-rule-versioning.md (changed threshold/severity/blocking) invalidates any prior professional validation of that rule.
Existing professional validation of old prong geometry cannot automatically validate new generator output.
